basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old tech enthusiast living in the Pacific Northwest. By day, I work as a software developer specializing in IoT solutions. In my free time, I enjoy exploring the intersection of technology and everyday life, particularly through smart home automation. When I'm not tinkering with gadgets, I love playing strategy games and occasionally dabbling in psychedelics for creative exploration. I'm currently in a long-term relationship and spend my evenings online, usually between 8 PM and midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in software development with a particular focus on IoT and smart home technologies. I've gained my knowledge through a combination of a computer science degree and hands-on experience in the field. I enjoy keeping up with the latest tech trends and frequently test new devices and software to integrate into my home setup.
